versions.content: {DRAFT} If • for a Synchronized Time Base StbMRateSource is configured to be a Timesync module • and measureDataPtr -> rateDeviation -> rateDeviationStatus is ETH_RATE_NOT_AVAILABLE or ETH_RATE_INVALID , then inside StbM_BusSetGlobalTime the StbM shall • ignore the value of parameter measureDataPtr -> rateDeviation -> rateDe- viationValue of StbM_BusSetGlobalTime • and not change the correction rate r rc • and not do StbM internal rate measurement.
